description_en: Queries the evaluation results of rules for a resource from the resource dimension
description_zh: 从资源维度查询规则对资源的评估结果
kebab_example: aliyun config list-resource-evaluation-results --resource-type ACS::RAM::User --resource-id 236426606353960000 --risk-level 1 --sort-by LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp-Asc --compliance-type NON_COMPLIANT --next-token IWBjqMYSy0is7zSMGu160000 --max-results 10 --biz-region global --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourceEvaluationResults

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

For information about how to obtain the resource type, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

关于如何获取资源类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID.

For information about how to obtain the resource ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。

关于如何获取资源ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:
1: high risk.
2: medium risk.
3: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
规则的风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en: By default, no value is passed. Currently supported: `LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp-Asc`, which sorts resources so that those that became non-compliant earliest appear first. Use this parameter together with the `ComplianceType` parameter set to `NON_COMPLIANT`
parameters.help_zh: 默认不传值。当前支持：`LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp-Asc`，越早开始出现不合规的资源则排序越靠前。应配合设置`ComplianceType`字段为`NON_COMPLIANT`使用
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: not applicable.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: insufficient data.
IGNORED: ignored
parameters.help_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据。
IGNORED：已忽略
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_en: If the request is truncated, use `NextToken` to initiate a new request to retrieve the content after the truncation point
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in a single request. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of resource ownership. For example, `global` indicates global, and `cn-hangzhou` indicates China (Hangzhou).

For information about how to obtain the region ID of resource ownership, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源归属的地域ID，例如：`global`表示全球，`cn-hangzhou`表示华东1（杭州）。

关于如何获取资源归属的地域ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.name: region

EvaluationResultList.description_en: The list of resource evaluation results

Annotation.description_en:
The supplementary information about the non-compliant resource. The following information may be included:

`configuration`: the current actual configuration of the resource, which is the non-compliant configuration.
`desiredValue`: the expected configuration of the resource, which is the compliant configuration.
`operator`: the comparison operator between the current configuration and the expected configuration.
`property`: the JSON path of the current configuration in the resource property struct.
`reason`: the reason for non-compliance
Annotation.description_zh:
不合规资源的补充信息。可能包含以下信息：

`configuration`：资源当前实际配置，即资源不合规配置。
`desiredValue`：资源期望配置，即资源合规配置。
`operator`：资源当前配置和期望配置之间的比较运算符。
`property`：当前配置在资源属性结构体中的JSON路径。
`reason`：资源不合规原因

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: not applicable.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: insufficient data.
IGNORED: ignored
ComplianceType.description_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：

NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据。
IGNORED：已忽略

ConfigRuleInvokedTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the rule was triggered to perform evaluation. Unit: milliseconds
ConfigRuleInvokedTimestamp.description_zh: 规则被触发执行评估的时间戳。单位：毫秒

EvaluationId.description_en: The unique ID of the evaluation result

EvaluationResultIdentifier.description_en: The identifier of the resource evaluation result

EvaluationResultQualifier.description_en: The resource information in the evaluation result
EvaluationResultQualifier.description_zh: 资源评估结果中的资源信息

ConfigRuleArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the rule

IgnoreDate.description_en: The automatic recovery date for the ignored evaluation result, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD. An empty value indicates that the result will not be automatically recovered and must be manually recovered
IgnoreDate.description_zh: 已忽略评估结果的自动恢复日期，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD。为空表示不会自动恢复，需要手动恢复

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of resource ownership

OrderingTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp displayed on the timeline. Unit: milliseconds
OrderingTimestamp.description_zh: 时间轴展示的时间戳。单位：毫秒

InvokingEventMessageType.description_en:
The trigger mechanism of the rule. Valid values:
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: configuration change.
ScheduledNotification: periodic execution.
Manual: manual trigger
InvokingEventMessageType.description_zh:
规则触发机制。取值：
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：配置变更。
ScheduledNotification：周期执行。
Manual：手动触发

LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.description_en: The start time of the most recent non-compliant status, expressed as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.description_zh: 最近一次不合规状态的起始时间，使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒
LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.title_en: 最近一次不合规的起始时间
LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.title_zh: 最近一次不合规的起始时间

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned in a single request
